fields.name: Aigaleo DC Cinema
fields.description: If you’re looking for the perfect night out in the heart of Aigaleo, DC Cinema is your go-to destination! From the latest global blockbusters to hand-picked cinematic gems, we offer you the ultimate viewing experience.

fields.title: The Lord of the Rings
fields.description: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

fields.title: Interstellar
fields.description: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.

fields.title: Fight Club
fields.description: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more.

fields.title: A Clockwork Orange
fields.description: Alex DeLarge and his droogs barbarize a decaying near-future.

fields.title: Johnny Got His Gun
fields.description: During World War I, a patriotic young American is rendered blind, deaf, limbless, and mute by a horrific artillery shell attack. Trapped in what's left of his body, he desperately looks for a way to end his life.
